document.cue: Describe a wedding you have attended.

text: I'd like to describe my cousin Dana's wedding, which took place last August in a big restaurant in Shymkent, where most of my mother's family live.

Kazakh weddings are famous for being enormous, and this one was no exception — there must have been about four hundred guests. Before the main celebration there was a smaller ceremony called betashar, where the bride's face is uncovered while a singer performs a traditional song and gives her advice about married life.

The evening itself went on for almost six hours. There was a live band, endless dishes of beshbarmak and salads, and a toastmaster who kept inviting relatives to the microphone to make speeches. At one point my uncle gave such an emotional toast that half the room was in tears, and then five minutes later everyone was dancing.

As for how I felt, I was mostly delighted, because I hadn't seen some of my relatives for years, and it was lovely to catch up with them. To be honest, though, by midnight I was absolutely exhausted, and my feet were aching from all the dancing.
Looking back, it was one of those days that remind you how big and close your family really is, and I think that's what weddings here are really about.

tips.en: Tears, then dancing five minutes later — a lively scene shows the atmosphere.
tips.kk: Көз жас, ал бес минуттан кейін би — жанды көрініс атмосфераны береді.
tips.ru: Слёзы, а через пять минут танцы — живая сцена передаёт атмосферу.
tips.example: half the room was in tears

tips.en: There must have been makes a confident guess about the past.
tips.kk: There must have been — өткен туралы сенімді болжам.
tips.ru: There must have been — уверенное предположение о прошлом.
tips.example: there must have been about four hundred guests

note.en: Whose wedding, where and when: two bullets in the first sentence.
note.kk: Кімнің тойы, қайда және қашан — карточканың екі тармағы бірінші сөйлемде.
note.ru: Чья свадьба, где и когда — два пункта карточки в первой фразе.

note.en: A local custom is explained, so the examiner understands what betashar is.
note.kk: Жергілікті дәстүр түсіндірмесімен: емтихан алушыға betashar не екені түсінікті.
note.ru: Местный обычай с пояснением: экзаменатору понятно, что такое betashar.

note.en: The “what happened” bullet: scenes in order and one vivid moment.
note.kk: «Не болды» тармағы — көріністер ретімен және бір жарқын сәт.
note.ru: Пункт «что происходило» — сцены по порядку и один яркий момент.

note.en: Feelings told honestly: joy and tiredness, each with a reason.
note.kk: Сезімдер шынайы: қуаныш пен шаршау, әрқайсысының себебі бар.
note.ru: Чувства честно: радость и усталость, у каждого — причина.

note.en: The ending sums up what weddings mean in this culture.
note.kk: Қорытынды оқиғаның мәнін жалпылайды — бұл мәдениетте той нені білдіреді.
note.ru: Итог обобщает смысл события — что значит свадьба в этой культуре.
